mapper.sql: links AS ( SELECT g.input_lot_no, g.output_lot_no, g.qty, g.result_id, g.linked_at FROM lot_genealogy g LEFT JOIN work_result r ON r.result_id = g.result_id WHERE r.result_id IS NULL OR r.cancelled = 0 )

SELECT t.trace_level, t.parent_lot_no, t.lot_no, l.item_code, i.item_name, i.item_type, l.last_process, p.process_name, t.qty AS link_qty, l.status, l.wo_no, t.result_id, t.linked_at FROM trace t JOIN lot l ON l.lot_no = t.lot_no JOIN item i ON i.item_code = l.item_code LEFT JOIN process p ON p.process_code = l.last_process ORDER BY t.sort_path OPTION (MAXRECURSION 50)
